description: Find Steam games by name or by genre/tag words (e.g. 'elden ring', 'final fantasy 7', 'cozy farming', 'soulslike'). Returns up to 20 games with Steam review score and count, year, top community tags and a steamcozy.com link. Use fetch with a result's id for the full record. Adult-only titles are never returned.

query.description: Game name or genre/tag words, any language.

name: search

id.description: Steam app id; pass to fetch.

snippet.description: Review score and count, year, top tags.

title: Search Steam games on SteamCozy
